messages:
emma: Quick sync: we need a tight minimal GA for private deploy focusing on VPC/on-prem packaging + upgrade safety. Goal: freeze scope by Friday.

claire: Agreed. Must include explicit IP continuity story, a peering handoff runbook, and an offline install path for airgapped customers.

devon: Technical proposal: GA supports cloud peering (BGP/cloud-peering) + customer BGP. Relay/agent mode stays tech-preview.

mike: Runtime constraints: add operator upgrade hook (canary control-plane -> wait for KV warm -> roll data-plane). Provide a kubectl validation script customers can run after upgrade.

sara: Field asks: a 10-minute quickstart the customer can hand to netops, plus an email template for scheduling the maintenance window.

priya: Security: signed installer artifacts, BYO-KMS patterns, least-priv IAM templates for peering, and a short audit-log routing guide for SIEMs.

emma: Draft launch gates:
- Signed installer + offline tarball validated on 2 distros
- IP continuity validated in 2 clouds + on-prem scenario
- Peering quickstart + IAM templates published
- BYO-KMS doc and audit-log integration guide
- Customer-run smoke test and support playbook
If any gate fails -> limited GA (field enablement only).

ops-bot: Created ticket RDW-PL-6120 "Private deploy minimal GA: networking & packaging" assigned @devon @mike @sara. ETA: 8bd.

claire: Owners noted. Please drop drafts in /docs/private and tag this thread. Reconvene next Tue for sign-off. :thumbsup:
